subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Demand vs. Sales
description: A quick win: understand Demand vs. Sales.

hook.text: A store sold 100 units last week. But 30 customers left empty-handed because the shelf was bare.

buildup.text: Sales data shows what you sold. Demand data shows what customers actually wanted—including unmet demand.

discovery.text: True demand includes lost sales, backorders, and substitutions that sales records never capture.

twist.text: Forecasting on sales alone underestimates demand. You plan for what you sold, not what you could have sold.

climax.text: Adjusting for stockouts and constraints gives a truer demand signal and a better forecast.

punchline.text: Sales tell you what happened. Demand tells you what was needed.

quiz.question: Why is sales data alone insufficient for forecasting?
options: It misses unmet demand like stockouts
